  variables:
    - rcv_time:
        comment: 1st column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: Seconds past 12:00:00 noon of January 1, 2000 in Receiver Time
        units: seconds
    - GRACEFO_id:
        comment: 2nd column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: GRACE-FO satellite identifier
        units: char
        valid_range: C,D
        value_meanings:
          - C = GRACE-FO 1 (GRACE C)
          - D = GRACE-FO 2 (GRACE D)
    - clock_id:
        comment: 3rd column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: Clock ID
    - eps_time:
        comment: 4th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: Clock offset.  GPS Time = rcv_time + eps_time
        units: seconds
    - eps_err:
        comment: 5th column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: Formal error of eps_time
        units: seconds
        valid_range: modelResult
    - eps_drift:
        comment: 6th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: Clock drift, or 1st time derivative of eps_time
        units: s/s
    - drift_err:
        comment: 7th column
        coverage_content_type: modelResult
        long_name: Formal error of eps_drift
        units: s/s
    - qualflg:
        comment: 8th column
        coverage_content_type: qualityInformation
        flag_masks: 1b, 2b, 4b, 8b, 16b, 32b
        flag_meanings:
          - bit 0 = Linear extrapolation of eps_time not valid AFTER rcv_time
          - bit 1 = Linear extrapolation of eps_time not valid BEFORE rcv_time
          - bit 2 = Smoothed data lies before center of smoothing for start midnight
          - bit 3 = Smoothed data lies after center of smoothing for start midnight
          - bit 4 = Smoothed data lies before center of smoothing for end midnight
          - bit 5 = Smoothed data lies after center of smoothing for end midnight
          - bits 6-7 = Not defined
        long_name: Quality Flags, bit 0 is rightmost
